finalText:
Build's green now, 0 errors.

Two spots hadn't caught up with the bump. `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount` — so it crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`. Fixed by reading the right field.

`isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false` and threw on anything else. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, which tripped that throw. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled, same as before.

The other 8 warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, not bugs — left those alone.
